obs = observe()
mug = obs["objects"]["red_mug"]
tray = obs["zones"]["cyan_tray"]

# Check if tray is occupied

    obj["center"][2] > tray["center"][2] + 0.005
    for obj in obs["objects"].values()
    if obj["center"][0] > tray["center"][0] - tray["half_size"][0]
    and obj["center"][0] < tray["center"][0] + tray["half_size"][0]

    and obj["center"][1] < tray["center"][1] + tray["half_size"][1]

    for obj in obs["objects"].values():
        if (tray["center"][0] - tray["half_size"][0] < obj["center"][0] < tray["center"][0] + tray["half_size"][0]
            and tray["center"][1] - tray["half_size"][1] < obj["center"][1] < tray["center"][1] + tray["half_size"][1]
            and obj["center"][2] > tray["center"][2] + 0.005):
            # Move to above the object
            move_to(obj["center"][0], obj["center"][1], obs["table_z"] + 0.2)
            # Descend to grasp height
            move_to(obj["center"][0], obj["center"][1], obj["center"][2] + 0.05)
            open_gripper()
            move_to(obj["center"][0], obj["center"][1], obs["table_z"] + 0.2)
            break

Next, check if the orange_tray is occupied. If it is, clear the object currently on it before placing the blue_book. Then, move the blue_book to the orange_tray. Success is confirmed when both the red_mug is on the cyan_tray and the blue_book is on the orange_tray, with no other objects on those trays.
